smartCut.tooltip: Smart cut: remove long pauses and filler words
smartCut.panelHint: Pauses are detected automatically; transcribe to also find filler words. Review, then trim.
smartCut.transcribeHint: First run downloads a speech model; transcription takes tens of seconds. Detection isn't perfect — adjust on the timeline.
smartCut.hint: Every removal makes an undoable cut (⌘Z); the timeline ripples shut and shortens.

review.title: Review word-by-word
review.hint: Click a word to toggle cut/keep: red strikethrough = will cut, amber = detected filler. Applying makes an undoable cut.

subtitles.needTranscribe: Transcribe first (Detect fillers), then generate subtitles
